message:
Your own personal STORE is now live on Reef Market! 🪸🐠
You can now create a fully searchable storefront to showcase all of your corals in one organized place. Instead of individual listings being scattered around, buyers can now visit your page and browse everything you have available by category.
✅ Create your own store name
✅ Upload a logo, reef tank photo, or custom image
✅ Organize what your selling into categories
✅ Make your profile easier for buyers to search and discover
✅ Build your own brand inside Reef Market
Whether you’re a hobbyist fragging your first corals or a serious collector with a full setup, this gives everyone a cleaner and more professional way to sell and showcase their reef.
Go set up your store and show off your reef! 🌊🔥
